items.docs: This API endpoint retrieves a paginated list of all defined versions associated with a specific repository in Bitbucket. By making a GET request to /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/versions, users can access version information that is typically used for issue tracking and release management within the repository. info.name: Atlassian Get Defined Version for Issues

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs: This GET operation retrieves a specific defined version for issues within a Bitbucket repository by accessing the endpoint /repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/versions/{version_id}. It requires three path parameters: the workspace identifier, the repository slug (a URL-friendly repository name), and the version_id of the specific version you want to retrieve.
